source: Transcribed from the Tektronix MDO4000C/MDO4000B/MDO4000/MSO4000B/DPO4000B/MDO3000 Programmer Manual, with the MSO4000/DPO4000 Programmer Manual (077-0248-01) adding the earlier models. Categories are the guide's own command Groups. Cross-checked against Tektronix' tm_devices, python-ivi tektronix* and pymeasure for the shared subset. A sweep on 10 August 2026 found 37 entries not in the guide as written, and unlike the other catalogs checked that day most of the fault was this file's: an automatic extraction had left debris nobody read back. Twenty-three entries were removed and eight repaired, taking the catalog from 2054 to 2031. Removed were nineteen duplicates of entries already here in correct form — CH<x>:PRObe:MODel<String> and PROPDELay<NR3> with the argument glued to a mnemonic the guide ends at MODel; fifteen carrying a literal SEARCH1, B1..B4, D5, D7 or REF2 where this catalog writes SEARCH:SEARCH<x>, B<x>, D<x> and REF<x>; ZOO:ZOOM1:STATE and ZOOM:ZOOM1:STATE beside a correct ZOOm:ZOOM<x>:STATE — plus four more that spelled the USB error type ERRORTYPe, a mnemonic the guide never prints: it prints USB:ERRTYPE seventeen times, and the correct entries were already here. Every one of the removed carried a description scraped from an appendix rather than the command reference, which is how they were told apart from the entries they duplicated. The eight repairs stripped '; Ranges={D,-1e6,+1E6}' and its kin from the syntax of seven POWer commands, moving each range into the description, and corrected POWer:REFLevel:ABSolute:MID<1-3> to MID<x>, which is what the guide prints and what the PERCent branch beside it already said. The range note is the guide's own — it appears on its Syntax lines — but ';' separates commands in SCPI, so the string as printed cannot be sent. Twenty-one entries did not appear in that manual and were left alone, because the MSO4000/DPO4000 Programmer Manual this catalog also covers was not kept in datasheets/ and there was nothing here to check them against. It was fetched on 11 August 2026 — 077-0248-01, from Tektronix's own download server — and all twenty-one are in it: WFMOutpre:FRACTional?, MEASUrement:SNAPShot, SAVe:EVENTtable:BUS<x>, SELect:BUS<x>, the TRIGger:A:VIDeo:CUSTom:SCAN and HDtv:FORMat pairs, TRIGger:B:UPPerthreshold:CH<x>, and the LOGIc:PATtern:INPut and SETHold:THReshold groups under both TRIGger and SEARCH. Nothing in this catalog is now unaccounted for, and both manuals it names are on disk.
